name: Sure Granny, let's get you to bed.
source:
Oops, you seem to have parked (crashed) right on Granny's mansion!
You being an alien of considerable acting talent, a plan quickly forms in your mind.

It's easy: All you have to do, is get Granny to bed before she realizes that her house is gone and her family is dead (on her birthday). 
As soon as she's gone to sleep you can fix your ship and leave earth again. 

Can you act your way out of this little mishap?

[From [url=https://hebdi.itch.io/sure-granny]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
哎呀，你好像把车停在了奶奶的豪宅上！
你是一个具有相当表演天赋的外星人，你的脑海里很快就形成了一个计划。

这很简单：你所要做的就是让奶奶上床睡觉，然后她才意识到她的房子不见了，她的家人都死了（在她生日那天）。
一旦她睡着了，你就可以修复你的飞船并再次离开地球。

你能采取行动摆脱这个小不幸吗？

[来自[url=https://hebdi.itch.io/sure-granny]itch.io[/url]]
